sources.title: Gemma 4 12B: The Developer Guide - Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: Meet Gemma 4 12B: the first medium-sized, encoder-free multimodal model capable of natively ingesting audio and video. Ideal for local AI development with 16GB VRAM, Hugging Face integrations, and drop-in local API servers.

sources.title: Gemma 4 12B The unified multimodal model that fits a 16GB laptop
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 12B: encoder-free unified multimodal model with text, image, audio and video input, 256K context and 6.7 GB at 4-bit. Best transcription in the Gemma 4 family, benchmarks, downloads, fine-tuning and limitations.
